caption:
My husband is a Dentist & he creates ✨smile makeovers✨

When analyzing smiles, he looks for the following:

1. Crowded Teeth
Teeth that overlap or crowd together are harder to clean and can trap plaque. Invisalign gradually creates space and alignment.

2. Gaps Between Teeth
Small spaces between teeth can collect food and affect smile symmetry. Invisalign can close gaps and create a more balanced smile.

3. Teeth That Stick Out or Lean Inward
Teeth that tilt forward or inward affect bite balance and smile harmony. Invisalign helps guide them back into proper position.

4. Bite Issues
Overbites, underbites, and crossbites can lead to uneven wear and jaw strain. Invisalign can help improve bite alignment over time.

5. Uneven Smile Line
When teeth don’t follow the natural curve of the lips, the smile can look unbalanced. Invisalign helps create a smoother, more symmetrical smile.
